SELECT invoice_number, avg_quantity, relative_gap, avg_quantity - overall_avg_quantity AS quantity_difference
FROM (
  SELECT invoice_number,
         AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity,
         (AVG(derived_product_cost) - AVG(derived_total_cost)) / AVG(derived_total_cost) AS relative_gap,
         AVG(AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL))) OVER () AS overall_avg_quantity
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
)
WHERE avg_quantity > overall_avg_quantity
ORDER BY quantity_difference DESC
LIMIT 10
